audience: retail shops and restaurants that run sales and purchases in Vendty

useCases.title: Review the sales of a period and the payment methods used
useCases.text: List the sales of a date range, which can span at most 90 days. Open one sale to read its lines and payments, and list the payment methods.

useCases.title: Find a customer by tax ID and review its sales
useCases.text: Search the customers by tax ID, then read the customer. List the sales of that customer to see its history.

useCases.title: Check the open orders on restaurant tables
useCases.text: List the restaurant tables with their live state. Open the active order of one table to read its items and kitchen state.

useCases.title: Review products and purchase invoices from suppliers
useCases.text: List the products and open one to read its details. List the suppliers and their purchase invoices.

useCases.title: Check the warehouses, taxes and price lists setup
useCases.text: List the warehouses, taxes and price lists configured for the business, to check the setup.
